title: Flatness of finite locally free étale coefficient sheaves
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, X a scheme, L a sheaf of Λ-modules on the small etale site of X, and t a natural number. Use the canonical constant-ring sheaf and its coefficient realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. If this realization of L is finite locally free of rank t, then L is a flat object of the category of fixed-ring sheaves of Λ-modules: tensoring by L on either side is exact. Rank zero and the zero coefficient ring are allowed.

source.place: Section Flat modules, lemmas flatness-sheafification-refined and flatness-local; local finite free bases.

proof.text: Choose the covering with basis of rank t for the realized module. Since the scalar sheaf is the sheafification of the constant ring, its stalk at each geometric point is Λ. Sheafification and the local basis maps identify the fixed-ring stalk of L with a finite free Λ-module. Finite free modules are flat, including rank zero. The jointly conservative geometric fibre criterion Etale.flat_iff_forall_flat_sheafFiber_obj proves flatness of L.
